# 2026-05-26

- [ ] Achnasheen morning round, check the down ewe from last week
- [ ] Ring Rhona re [[Autumn TB Round]] running order
- [ ] Drug fridge temps logged
- Home by seven, stew with Fiona

# 2026-05-25

- [x] Applecross pony, abscess drained, sound again
- [ ] Invoice [[Achnasheen herd]] visit
- Long drive back, dry roads for once

# 2026-05-24

- [x] Sunday walk with Fiona, then lunch at the croft
- Father's hip slow but steady
- Batch cook for the week

# Autumn TB Round

28 herds, October to December, coordinated with Rhona Matheson at APHA.

- Achnasheen first, 1 October
- Torridon and Applecross through mid-November
- Remote Sutherland to close
- Reporting deadline 20 November

# Drug Stock

- Reorder oxytetracycline after this week's calvings
- Metacam holding, 4 bottles
- Lambing gloves low, on next [[MWI]] order
- Keep £5,000 business buffer for stock and vehicle

# Achnasheen herd

Duncan Fraser, 400 ewes and 80 suckler cattle.

- Down ewe 28 April, staggers, recovered
- TB test due 1 October
- Watch the older cows post-calving

# Calving notes

- Retained cleansing: do not pull, review temperature, cover only if it climbs (Jean's steer)
- Calcium and magnesium in the kit for staggers
- Calving jack checked and clean

# Munro list

87 of 282.

- Beinn Liath Mhor
- Maol Chean-dearg
- Fuar Tholl
- Sgorr Ruadh
- Repeat favourites over ticking

# Quick capture

- Norway trip, last week of September, square on-call with Graeme
- Series III: source period-correct door seals
- Ask Douglas about Harrogate as professional development
